title: Oily Crispy Croatian Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring minced pork, infused oil, and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a comforting meal on a sick day.

ingredients.name: minced pork
ingredients.notes: preferably with a high fat content

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the minced pork, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Gradually add the all-purpose flour to the pork mixture, mixing until a dough forms.
Add the egg to the dough and mix until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for about 5 minutes, until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape, and then use your thumbs to create a depression in the center of each disk.
Heat the infused oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, and when the oil is hot, add a few of the dumplings to the skillet, being careful not to overcrowd.
Fry the dumplings until they are crispy and golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the dumplings from the oil with a slotted spoon, and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives if desired.
